headline: EPA extends RFS compliance deadline as refiners run flat-out amid supply crunch
intro: Crack spreads are blowing out and refiners are sprinting at max capacity — and just as the squeeze peaks, EPA hands them a breather on biofuel blending paperwork.
overview: Diesel and gasoline cracks remain elevated ($104.62/bbl and $54.68/bbl respectively) as US refiners run near record utilization amid Iran-related supply disruptions and Russian refinery strikes tightening global product markets. EPA's move to extend the September 1 RFS compliance deadline offers refiners some relief on biofuel blending obligations, while Reuters flags historic stress on the US refining system as a global fuel supply crisis takes shape. Meanwhile NYMEX RBOB and ULSD both posted sharp weekly gains, and a California bill would codify refinery worker safety protections following past fires and explosions.

stories.title: US EPA to extend renewable fuel standard compliance deadline for refiners
stories.summary: EPA plans to extend the September 1 deadline for refiners to demonstrate compliance with the nation's biofuel blending laws, the agency said Friday.

stories.title: EPA extends deadline for refiners to comply with renewable fuel standard
stories.summary: EPA announced in a Friday notice that it would extend the deadline for oil refiners to comply with the renewable fuel standard.

stories.title: US refiners face historic stress test as global crisis looms
stories.summary: US refineries have operated near maximum capacity for the longest sustained period in over a quarter century as they scramble to capture windfall profits from the Iran war, though history suggests risks ahead.

stories.title: Global refining disruptions turn the oil shock into a fuel supply crisis
stories.summary: Pressure in global energy markets is shifting from crude oil toward refining capacity, with record margins, disrupted capacity, and tighter exports creating a fuel supply crisis.

stories.title: Nymex Overview: Crude and Product Prices End the Day, Week Higher -- OPIS
stories.summary: Crude oil and refined product futures ended the day and week higher Friday as markets price in possible disruptions to global petroleum supplies.

stories.title: Front Month Nymex RBOB Gasoline Rose 5.14% This Week to Settle at $3.3479 — Data Talk
stories.summary: Front-month NYMEX RBOB gasoline for September delivery gained 16.38 cents/gal, or 5.14%, to settle at $3.3479 for the week.

stories.title: Front Month Nymex ULSD Rose 4.95% This Week to Settle at $4.4948 — Data Talk
stories.summary: Front-month NYMEX ULSD for September delivery gained 21.19 cents/gal, or 4.95%, to settle at $4.4948 for the week — the largest two-week gain since late July.

stories.title: US Refiners Face Import Crunch from Top Crude Seller
stories.summary: US refiners face a looming supply drop from their biggest foreign crude supplier just as they need the oil most.

stories.title: California bill would secure safeguards for refinery workers after long history of fires, explosions
stories.summary: California lawmakers are considering a bill to place current refinery-worker safety protections into state law while regulators rework rules under an industry settlement.

stories.title: Court Upholds Trump Admin Order to Restart SYU
stories.summary: A court upheld the Trump administration's order to restart the Santa Ynez Unit (SYU), which the Justice Department called a win for domestic energy production.

stories.title: Oil Rises as US Targets Iran's Economy
stories.summary: Crude extended its rally as Asian demand strengthened while the Iran conflict continued to constrain global supplies.

stories.title: Ukraine's Fire Point confirms strikes on oil refinery and Ozon warehouse in Russia's Samara region
stories.summary: Ukraine's Fire Point confirmed drone strikes on the Novokuybyshevsk oil refinery in Russia's Samara region overnight.

stories.title: Lukoil’s Perm refinery struck 1,530 km from Ukraine’s northern border, Kyiv confirms
stories.summary: Lukoil's Perm refinery was struck 1,530 km from Ukraine's northern border, part of an overnight wave that also hit a military airfield in Volgograd Oblast.

stories.title: Can Phillips 66, Marathon, or Valero Afford Delek US Holdings Now?
stories.summary: Delek US has surged past its own analyst targets, with its CEO saying all options are on the table for a potential sale to a major refiner.
